sources.title: tokino_sora_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The current default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Tokino Sora]]. It has been her default appearance since May 2018. 
 
It consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[collared shirt|collared]] [[cropped shirt]], a [[blue vest|blue]] [[cropped vest]], a [[red bowtie]] or a [[red ribbon|red]] [[neck ribbon]], [[wrist cuffs]], a [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]], a white [[waist cape]] with a [[rabbit tail|bunny]] [[fake tail|tail]], [[blue thighhighs]], a [[blue ribbon]] [[thigh ribbon|around her left thigh]] and [[blue boots|blue]] [[winged boots|winged]] [[ankle boots|ankle]] [[fold-over boots]] with [[high heel boots|high heel]]s. While her model would receive further updates after to improve its quality, her base costume would be iterated upon with its update for her 3rd Anniversary in 2020, with the additions to it being used to this day. 
 
She has a more elaborate variation of her main costume, which was introduced for her first album [i]Dreaming![/i]. Her costume remains mostly the same but is generally more ornamented, with the addition of [[gold trim]] and an [[aiguillette]] on her vest, [[frills]] on her [[frilled cuffs|cuffs]],  [[gold chain]]s on her waistcape, and [[lace trim]] on her [[lace-trimmed skirt|skirt]]. Additionally she wears a short [[underbust]] [[corset]] and [[bracelet]]s with this costume. 
 
For her original design and its variations, see [[Tokino Sora (old design)]].
